_comment: THE one place for the packaged app's layout under process.resourcesPath (macOS AgentLink.app/Contents/Resources, Windows <install>/resources). Read by src/main/main.ts (resourcePaths) and by build/lib/stage.mjs + build-mac/win.mjs. The core is the packed CLI tarball installed with npm --prefix core, so its desktop host is the CLI's second bundle dist/desktop-host.js (AGENTLINK_BUNDLE_ENTRY=desktop-host). Paths are path segments.
